a_aggregatorBlocksMerge.detail: customizer-regressions added to needs: [detect-changes, install-deps] with the standard per-step detect-changes code/e2e skip gate (pr-checks.yml lines 578-648, job added between seam-anchors and desktop-typecheck). lint-and-test's needs array (pr-checks.yml lines 700-721) now includes customizer-regressions alongside the other 18 members; the aggregator's 'Assert every fan-out check succeeded' step (lines 724-736) fails the run on any needed job whose toJSON(needs) result is not 'success', including a job that reports success-but-skipped-steps on a docs-only PR. A documentation-only PR (no code/e2e path match) still passes because every working step inside customizer-regressions is gated behind the same detect-changes condition used by e2e-smoke/seam-anchors, so the job itself reports success with no-op steps.

b_playwrightInvocationExact.flagForOrchestrator: The task brief for this step named the flag '--workers=1', but the draft's actual step (pr-checks.yml line 638) uses '--trace=retain-on-failure' instead and carries NO '--workers=1'. This is NOT a defect in the draft -- it is the brief's expectation that is stale. design.md Decision 3 states the gate run in full: 'node scripts/playwright/run-playwright.mjs test e2e/customizer-equipment-catalog.spec.ts e2e/customizer-record-sheet-rendering.spec.ts e2e/customizer-edit-recovery.spec.ts --project=chromium --retries=0 --trace=retain-on-failure' -- no --workers=1, and the rationale given is explicit: 'A gate must not retry a flaky regression to green ... but zero retries makes the configured trace mode dead: no first retry, no trace ... The invocation therefore carries --trace=retain-on-failure ... so a failing run keeps its trace.' The already-merged job-scoped contract module (scripts/qc/openspec-ci-contracts.mjs, requiredWorkflowJobContracts[0].requiredRuns[2].run) pins this exact string byte-for-byte, also without --workers=1 (playwright.config.ts already sets workers: 1 globally for CI, per its own comment in nightly-validation.yml, so the flag would be redundant, not wrong, but it is not part of the canonical/contracted command). I verified the draft's run string character-for-character against both design.md and openspec-ci-contracts.mjs and they match each other and the draft. Adding --workers=1 would deviate from the frozen contract string without any package-spec justification, so I left the draft as-is rather than 'fixing' it toward the brief's flag.

Counted test() cases directly in the three spec files in the root checkout: customizer-equipment-catalog.spec.ts=3, customizer-record-sheet-rendering.spec.ts=6, customizer-edit-recovery.spec.ts=3 (grep -n 'test(' on each file), totalling 12, confirming the job runs the shipped 12-case surface against the production standalone server (fetch-assets:true + validate:assets:strict at lines 596-602, npm run build with NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_MODE/NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_TEST at lines 604-609, both before the browser step).
